description: Set your Marketplace buyer name and location. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

location.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

name.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_market_update_buyer_account_settings
title: Market: update buyer account settings
